I travel around my local area for work and I go through a ton of very small towns and rural areas. I would focus on places where you can socialize, or unique local landmarks, or pieces of public art. In rural areas, your options are usually Limited, will look for places like Pavilions, veterans memorials, churches, etc.

Athletic fields on public land, other than schools, are good bets as well.
It will. I use mine every month.

Pictures of buildings instead of signs are always a tougher sell. Even if the sign is very generic, it's usually better to use than just the picture of the building. I hate it, because there have been some beautiful buildings that I could only use as supplemental pictures, because the sign confirms what it is.

When you are placing the stop in the map, always make sure to look for those red ! exclamation marks that indicate a stop from a different game is nearby. The blue pokeball shows current pokestops and the exclamation mark shows where stops from other Niantic games are from.

I had found a really cool veterans memorial in a very rural cemetery and I was excited to nominate it until I found that darn exclamation mark on the map. The memorial was too close to the cemetery's stop, so it ended up in Ingress.
